description: Market snapshot: crypto top 5, SI stocks, and metrics, with the snapshot timestamp. For the publication's dated predictions and their grades, use get_scoreboard instead. This is a snapshot baked when the site was last built, not live prices — the as_of field gives its timestamp, and the live ribbon on the website refreshes more often. Takes no parameters. Returns the snapshot object plus as_of and note fields. Behaviour: read-only and public — no authentication or API key; every call is logged in aggregate (tool name, result count, coarse client class; no IP addresses).
name: get_ticker
title: Get Market Ticker
